title: Plan
summary: Ordered steps one owner approves before the work starts.

facets.label: What changes
facets.hint: The edit or action, concretely enough to start on.

facets.label: Why
facets.hint: Only when the goal does not already explain it.

facets.label: Touches
facets.hint: Files, services, tables, or people it affects.

facets.label: Done when
facets.hint: The check that proves it, as a command where possible.

facets.label: Diff
facets.hint: A fenced diff, when the change is small enough to show.

facets.label: Risk
facets.hint: What could break, and how you would roll it back.

facets.label: Note
facets.hint: Anything the owner must know that fits nowhere else.

sections.title: Goal
sections.hint: The outcome, the constraints, and what is out of scope.

sections.title: Steps
sections.hint: One board per phase; steps number across phases.

sections.title: Verification
sections.hint: The commands or checks that prove the whole plan worked.

legend: Effort is agent time, not calendar time: S is under an hour, M is a few hours with review, L is a day or more across sessions.

decision.title: How to approve
decision.markdown: Say go, revise, or skip by step number. Numbers without a word mean go.
decision.example: go all; revise 4; skip 7. Notes: 4: split the migration.
